siteName: The Art of Storytelling Content Workshop with Akash
title: The Art of Storytelling Content Workshop with Akash
tagline: A beginner-friendly 2-day online workshop to start creating, experiment, and find your own style.

creator.name: Akash
creator.intro: Coming from a small town, I've built my name in the Marathi content creation space with 50M+ views, 2.5L+ followers and 8+ successful travel series, including Akash Challa 36 Divas 36 Jile and Unplanned Hampi.
creator.voiceSection: Akash has his own point of view when it comes to editing, storytelling, finding stories, and even approaching new and unknown people. That perspective is what makes his content special and what makes it truly his.

workshop.joinDetails: Workshop link and joining instructions will be sent to your email and WhatsApp after successful payment.

sections.title: Script Writing
items: Write meaningful short-form scripts
Create hooks nobody wants to skip
Break down Akash's real scripts and videos
Learn to create endings that leave a meaningful impact

sections.title: Visual Storytelling — Special Lecture by Siddhi Dalvi
sections.subtitle: Actor | Model | Assistant Director | DOP Assistant
items: Learn how to tell stories and bring emotions to life through visuals
Understand the aesthetic behind a frame
Learn how a DOP thinks
Explore angles, framing and shot sizes and the meaning behind them
Learn how to shoot effective B-rolls and why they matter

sections.title: Practicals & Homework
items: You get hands-on practicals and homework, not just theory
Everything taught in the session, you will actually do yourself
Write, shoot and edit your own story and get direction on it
Learn by creating — that is how the lessons truly stay with you

sections.title: Editing
items: Watch Akash break down how he edits his videos from start to finish
Understand how visuals, sound, music, stickers and pacing work together
Get a look at Akash's actual editing timelines
Watch him write, shoot and edit a video live

sections.title: Voiceover
items: Make your voice sound natural and engaging
Learn voice modulation, pauses and delivery

sections.title: Storytelling
items: Turn real-life experiences into stories worth telling
Learn how to start and end a story
Build emotion and keep your audience engaged
Become more confident on camera

privacy.refundPolicy: Refunds are available up to 48 hours before the workshop start date. After that, registrations are non-refundable. Contact the organizer for special cases.
